_how: Hand labels from frames I viewed with the Read tool (1 s contact sheets over 22-120 s, then 0.2 s sheets and zoomed crops around every candidate). Labels: real = another vehicle that is MOVING comes within ~1-2 m of the camera car (reportable kind of event); close_static = a real vehicle within ~1-2 m but parked/stationary, the camera car is the one passing (not reportable); unclear = within ~1-2 m but I cannot tell whether it moves; real_simulated = the injected cut-in (SIMULATED).
